messages:
nina: quick flag  We pushed an RBAC prune for keystore-access (remove stale unwrap/sign grants). Immediately after, canary regions reported mTLS failures between eu->apac. Proxy logs show KMS DENY on unwrap and AsymmetricSign. Please triage.

sam: paste from proxy-apac-5:
```
2026-03-28T11:21:02Z proxy-apac-5 audit=crypto DENY unwrap key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/egress/cryptoKeys/egress-keystore-v4 principal=svc-account:connector-eu@dataplane reason=permissionDenied
TLS alert: KEY_UNWRAP_FAILURE
```

blee: Looks like the prune logic filtered by last-used and accidentally removed long-lived cross-region connectors. That breaks runtime unwrap for existing certs and also signing for ephemeral cert minting.

nina: Ops: can we rollback the prune now? We need to restore availability first.

ops-bot: policy-change "keystore-prune-2026-03-28" applied by @nina at 2026-03-28T11:18:10Z. Suggested action: rollback if crypto ops fail.

sam: Rolling back at 11:23 UTC. While rollback runs, enable proxy fallback to use cached key material for 90s: `kubectl -n proxy annotate deploy/egress-proxy keystore.cache-ttl=90`

blee: Rollback completed at 11:24:05Z. KMS audit shows unwrap/asymmetricSign success for previously denied principals. Traffic recovered ~80s after rollback.

sec-oncall: P0 mitigated. Follow-ups: (1) add KMS DENY alerts: unwrap >5/min or AsymmetricSign >2/min (2) policy CI preflight: run `gcloud kms keys test-iam-permissions` for decrypt/asymmetricSign against all principals targeted by a prune across regions (3) update MR template to require explicit whitelist for cross-region service accounts and key-label aliasing so label renames don't break callers.

nina: I'll open INC-8100 and attach policy-diff + KMS audit window 11:15-11:30 UTC. Also drafting a conservative prune policy that preserves principals with any unwrap/sign activity in last 90 days.

sam: Also recommend we avoid coupling TLS cipher hardening and keystore RBAC changes in the same deploy window; separate by 24h. We'll add a deploy calendar guard.

ops-bot: incident/8100 created and linked to changelist-360987."
